chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام used to dye with henna and katam.

key_terms.بِالْحِنَّاءِ: with henna, a plant-based reddish dye
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, the person described in the report
key_terms.وَالْكَتَمِ: and katam, a plant used as a dark dye
key_terms.يَخْتَضِبُ: used to dye hair or beard

ai.seo_question: Did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام dye his hair with henna and katam?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام used henna and katam for dyeing. It reflects a practice of personal grooming and beautification associated with the Imam عليه السلام.
